title: Foamstep
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small single-pass 180-second stereo master; a continuous 128-second excerpt from 32s forms the station mix and its first 64 seconds form the game mix; -9.5 dB gain before AAC encoding. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: Create a 128-second stereo excerpt cut from the middle of an already-playing 140 BPM future bass dance chorus. A complete, loud kick, snare, hats, round bass, bright sidechained synth chords and bouncy pitched hook all sound on the first beat and continue at roughly even level through the last. Clear short attacks for a one-or-two-key rhythm game; playful three-low-two-high-note call and reply, with changed chord roots and answering octave in the second minute. Original, colorful, all-ages electronic instrumental. No beginning or ending of a song, no intro, riser, build, sparse bridge, breakdown, fade, silence, vocals, speech, samples, copying or tempo changes. Generate a full 180-second continuous performance so the 32-to-160-second section is a strong, stable, fully-arranged excerpt.

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Overlapping asymmetric foam-like polygon cushions lift a coral zigzag signal; no round bubbles, character, text or literal instrument; crisp high-contrast comic-print cover.
art_provenance.og_prompt: Wide duohertz title panel with angular foam layers on right and Foamstep on left.
art_provenance.render_method: local macOS sips SVG-to-PNG; source raster equality checked before staging
art_provenance.cover_svg: Local SVG title overlay around the authored cover-art.png
